Marble look tiles

Marble look tiles

Marble look tiles give you the veining of calacatta and statuario marble in a tile that is simpler to live with. We have 18 ranges, from soft white with grey veining to charcoal with gold accents. If you are looking for marble look tiles in Sydney, you can see them in person at our Bonnyrigg showroom.

The looks

Marble look tiles in white, grey and gold veining

Most marble looks start with a white or ivory base. BT Brazil Calcutta has flowing grey veining with warm gold highlights, and Calacatta Gold and Statuario Gold follow the two best known Italian marbles. For something darker, Monash has a charcoal base with white veining and gold accents.

BT Brazil Calcutta, BT Glacier and Cali Glacier are our own imports. You can see them with the rest of the our other BT Specials.

Marble or marble look

Marble look porcelain versus real marble

People choose a marble look because they want the pattern without the care that natural marble asks for.

Marble look porcelain or natural marble: which suits your home?

Marble look porcelainNatural marble
CostPriced like other porcelain tilesUsually costs more, and so does laying it
UpkeepNo sealing of the tile, everyday cleaners are fineNeeds sealing and re-sealing, and marks from acids such as lemon juice
DurabilityHard glazed surface that resists scratches and stainsSofter stone that can scratch, stain and etch
SlipDepends on the finish: matt grips better than polishedPolished marble is slippery when wet
PatternPrinted veining, repeated across a set of tile facesEvery slab is different

A general comparison. Ask our team about the finish and slip rating of the range you choose.

Pricing

Marble look tile prices

The priced marble look ranges on this page run from $22 to $40 per m², and each one lists its price by size. 9 ranges show Enquire Now: add them to your enquiry and our team confirms the price.

Larger sizes and polished finishes usually sit at the upper end of a range.

Finish

Polished, lappato or matt marble looks

Polished marble looks have the deepest shine and make the veining stand out. They suit walls and dry living areas. Lappato is a soft half polish that keeps some of the glow with less glare, and matt is the practical choice for bathroom floors.

Finishes listed across these ranges include In & Out, Lappato, Matt, Polish, Polished, Satin, Soft Matt and StoneTouch Tec. See tile finishes explained for how each one is made and where it works.

Sizes

Sizes from 300 x 300 to 750 x 1500

Marble looks come in 300 x 300, 300 x 600, 600 x 600, 600 x 1200 and 750 x 1500. 600 x 1200 suits a marble look well, because a longer tile gives the veining room to run before the next joint.

BT Glacier is the one range in 750 x 1500, and Ritz is the only one in 300 x 300.

Getting them

How to get marble look tiles: pick-up or delivery

Add the range and your area to an enquiry. Our team confirms stock, then you choose pick-up from Bonnyrigg or delivery across Sydney metro.

Polished tiles mark if they are dragged, so lift them out of the box rather than sliding them, and stack them on their edge.

Choosing

See the veining in person or try it in a room

A marble look is judged across several tiles, not one. In the showroom you can see a run of tiles side by side and how the veining changes from face to face.

At home, you can see the tile in a room with our visualiser before you visit. Planning a wet area? Start with the bathroom tile range.

Before you order

Batch and vein variation

Veining is meant to vary. Each range is printed across a set of different faces, so open several boxes and mix them as you lay, rather than working through one box at a time.

Batches also differ slightly in shade, so order the full area together. Our sales terms and conditions set out how returns work.

Upkeep

Low upkeep compared with stone

A marble look tile does not need sealing, and it will not etch if lemon juice or vinegar is spilt on it. Sweep, then mop with a pH neutral cleaner.

Polished finishes show water marks, so dry them with a soft cloth after mopping.

Marble look tiles

Marble look tile questions

Are marble look tiles cheaper than marble?

Generally, yes. Marble look tiles are priced like other porcelain tiles, and they cost less to lay and to look after than natural marble. The priced ranges on this page run from $22 to $40 per m².

Do marble look tiles need sealing?

No. The tile itself does not need sealing. Cement based grout can be sealed if you want extra protection against stains.

Are polished marble look tiles slippery?

Polished tiles are more slippery when wet than matt ones. Use polished finishes on walls and dry living areas, and choose a matt finish for bathroom floors.

What is the best size for marble look tiles?

600 x 1200 shows marble veining best, because the pattern runs further before a grout line. 600 x 600 suits smaller rooms, and 300 x 600 suits walls.

Can marble look tiles go in a shower?

Yes. Marble look tiles suit shower walls in any finish. For the shower floor choose a matt finish and check the slip rating with our team.

Where can I see marble look tiles in Sydney?

At our showroom in Bonnyrigg, in Sydney's south west, open Monday to Friday 7am to 5pm and Saturday 7am to 3pm. Seeing several tiles side by side shows how the veining varies.
